source: Bundled with agent-audit-kit: the PHP and Node.js vendor advisories, GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35, NVD and the CISA KEV catalog (2026.10.27), and endoflife.date, each read on 2026-10-28 (the url and read_at of each entry).

advisories.subject: php
advisories.title: PHP2Shell: remote code execution via out-of-memory corruption
advisories.notes: Fixed releases from the advisory; affected_from from NVD's CPE range (7.3.0 up to 8.2.35). KEV dates from the CISA catalog.

advisories.subject: php
advisories.title: PHP2Shell: remote code execution via stale global state
advisories.notes: Fixed releases from the advisory; affected_from from NVD's CPE range (5.4.0 up to 8.2.35). CRITICAL because it is in KEV; NVD scores it HIGH.

advisories.subject: node
advisories.title: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write in Node.js's bundled Brotli
advisories.cvss: Google CVSS 4.0 9.2; Node.js rates it high
advisories.notes: Node.js: 'affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x', fixed in v22.23.4, v24.22.1 and v26.12.1, and 'End-of-Life versions are always affected'. Node.js bundles Brotli from 11.7.0 and 10.16.0 (doc/changelogs), so older releases are not affected by this CVE. No 27.x existed on 2026-10-28.

advisories.subject: pypi:Brotli
advisories.title: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli bindings on PyPI
advisories.notes: GHSA: pip brotli >= 1.0.3, < 1.2.1, first patched 1.2.1. Upstream also fixed 1.0.10 and 1.1.1, but PyPI has neither: 1.2.1 (2026-10-22) is the only fixed release there.

advisories.subject: pypi:brotlicffi
advisories.title: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write in brotlicffi's bundled Brotli
advisories.notes: GHSA: pip brotlicffi >= 1.0.3, < 1.2.1.0, first patched 1.2.1.0 (2026-10-22); 1.2.0.0, 1.2.0.1 and 1.2.0.2 are affected.
